description: Kyutai 100M-parameter CPU-friendly TTS package set for real-time local synthesis and small-footprint voice cloning in English, German, Italian, Portuguese, and Spanish.

request.name: max_steps
request.description: Maximum acoustic generation frames per text chunk; default 0 estimates the cap from text length.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Text-conditioning token budget accepted by the PocketTTS generation path; default 50.

request.name: frames_after_eos
request.description: Acoustic frames to continue after the EOS head fires; default -1 uses the model recommendation or the text-length heuristic.

request.name: temperature
request.description: Positive acoustic sampling temperature. When omitted, PocketTTS uses the model config default: 0.3 for English built-in defaults and 0.7 for other built-in defaults.

request.name: noise_clamp
request.description: Clamp sampled latent noise to this positive magnitude; default -1 disables clamping.

request.name: eos_threshold
request.description: EOS logit threshold used to stop acoustic generation; default -4.0.

request.name: seed
request.description: Acoustic noise seed; omitted requests choose a random seed during session preparation.

request.name: noise_path
request.description: Optional binary float latent-noise schedule. The schedule must provide at least max_steps latent vectors.

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: Maximum UTF-8 codepoints per long-form text chunk; default 256.

request.name: voice_state_path
request.description: Optional prepared PocketTTS voice-state file to use instead of a named preset or reference audio.

request.name: truncate_clone_audio
request.description: Limit reference audio used for voice cloning to the first 30 seconds; default false.

session.name: voice_state_cache_slots
session.description: Prepared voice-state cache slots; default 4, set 0 to disable.

session.name: voice_state_export_path
session.description: Optional path where session preparation exports the prepared voice state for later reuse.

session.name: graph_capacity_mode
session.description: Graph capacity allocation strategy; default tiered on CPU host-graph backends and double otherwise.

session.name: prompt_graph_capacity
session.description: Fixed prompt graph capacity in acoustic prompt steps; default 0 lets the graph-capacity mode choose.

session.name: generation_graph_capacity
session.description: Fixed acoustic generation graph capacity in generated frames; default 0 lets the graph-capacity mode choose.

session.name: weight_context_mb
session.description: Default weight context size in MiB for FlowLM and Mimi weights; default 64.

session.name: flow_weight_context_mb
session.description: FlowLM weight context size in MiB; default inherits weight_context_mb.

session.name: mimi_encoder_weight_context_mb
session.description: Mimi encoder weight context size in MiB; default inherits weight_context_mb.

session.name: mimi_decoder_weight_context_mb
session.description: Mimi decoder weight context size in MiB; default inherits weight_context_mb.

session.name: flow_weight_view_context_mb
session.description: FlowLM temporary weight-view context size in MiB; default 256.

session.name: flow_step_graph_arena_mb
session.description: FlowLM step graph arena size in MiB; default 256.

session.name: mimi_encoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Mimi encoder graph arena size in MiB; default 512.

session.name: mimi_conv_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Mimi decoder convolution graph arena size in MiB; default 32.

session.name: mimi_transformer_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Mimi decoder transformer graph arena size in MiB; default 96.

session.name: mimi_tail_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Mimi decoder tail graph arena size in MiB; default 512.

session.name: mimi_full_chunk_frames
session.description: Mimi full-sequence decoder chunk size in codec frames; default 90.

session.name: mimi_stage2_chunk_frames
session.description: Mimi stage-2 decoder chunk size in codec frames; default 900.

session.name: use_full_mimi
session.description: Use the full-sequence Mimi decoder path instead of the streaming chunked path; default true.

session.name: matmul_weight_type
session.description: Matmul weight storage type; default native.

session.name: conv_weight_type
session.description: Convolution weight storage type; default native.
